quiz.0.question: From which area of Rome does Frascati originate?
quiz.0.options.0: The Roman hills north of Rome (Sabine Hills)
quiz.0.options.1: The Castelli Romani hills southeast of Rome
quiz.0.options.2: The volcanic plateau west of Rome
quiz.0.explanation: Frascati DOCG comes from the Castelli Romani hills in the Colli Albani area southeast of Rome — the cradle of Lazio's most famous white wine.
quiz.1.question: In the legend of Est! Est!! Est!!!, why did the servant write three 'Est' markings?
quiz.1.options.1: The wine was so good, one 'Est' (meaning 'it is here!') was not enough
quiz.1.options.2: He needed to mark three different barrels
quiz.1.options.3: It was three separate wine stops
quiz.1.explanation: According to legend, a bishop's servant marked 'Est' on inns with good wine. Finding the Montefiascone wine exceptional, he wrote 'Est! Est!! Est!!!' — three times to convey his enthusiasm.
quiz.2.question: What is Lazio's only red wine DOCG?
quiz.2.explanation: Cesanese del Piglio DOCG (also known as Piglio) is Lazio's only red wine DOCG, made from the indigenous Cesanese grape with complex, silky character.
quiz.3.question: Among Rome's four classic pasta dishes, which wine best complements Carbonara?
quiz.3.options.1: Frascati Superiore DOCG or Castelli Romani Bianco
quiz.3.explanation: The creamy richness of Carbonara pairs beautifully with the crisp acidity of local Frascati or Castelli Romani white wines — a classic regional pairing.
